svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: BNO08x: I2C
svg.desc: Schematic of the BNO08x i2c: the chip with U2 MCU, C1 capacitor 100 nF, C2 capacitor 100 nF, C3 capacitor 100 nF, R1 resistor 2.2 kΩ, R2 resistor 2.2 kΩ, R3 resistor 10 kΩ, R4 resistor 4.7 kΩ, R5 resistor 4.7 kΩ, Y1 crystal 32.768 kHz; the MCU wires carry the port hooks IntAsserted(), TakeIntTimestamp(), SetBootn(), SetReset(), SetWake(), transport hooks.
svg.text: The BNO08x on an MCU's I2C bus at address 0x4A (PS1, PS0 and SA0 low). H_INTN, NRST and BOOTN are on GPIOs the driver reads and drives through IntAsserted(),
SetReset() and SetBootn(); the crystal gives the 32.768 kHz clock. Above each MCU wire: the port hook that drives it. Datasheet: 1.2.2 I2C interface, p. 12.

* Not confirmed in the datasheet: R1 2.2 kΩ: the data sheet gives no value; size it for the bus; R2 2.2 kΩ: the data sheet gives no value; size it for the bus; R4 4.7 kΩ: the data sheet gives no value for the
environmental bus; R5 4.7 kΩ: the data sheet gives no value for the environmental bus.
